dataset: CERT Insider Threat Test Dataset r4.2
canonical_source: Carnegie Mellon University Software Engineering Institute

interpretation.summary: Only 3 of 70 CERT r4.2 malicious scenario windows directly fit the current identity -> file activity -> removable-media chain semantics. All 3 compatible windows satisfy the ordered proxy chain.
interpretation.why: CERT raw sources do not directly encode the project's src_ip, new_device, or sensitive-resource metadata semantics.
interpretation.benign_result: 300 sampled non-malicious-user windows; 7 formed the proxy chain. This is not a benign census.
